academic.summary: Product Owner, Scrum Master, Dev Team, Sprint, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Product Backlog

market_ready.hands_on_task: Simulate 2-week sprint: backlog refinement, planning, daily standups, review, retrospective. Dùng Jira hoặc Trello

questions.question: Sprint Retrospective mục đích là gì?

options.A: Team reflect trên process và identify improvements cho sprint tiếp theo

questions.explanation: Retrospective: inspect và adapt process (không phải product). 3 questions: What went well? What needs improvement? What actions to take? Sau khi Sprint Review (product). Scrum Master facilitate.

questions.question: Definition of Done (DoD) vs Acceptance Criteria khác nhau?

options.A: DoD: team-wide quality standards (test, code review, deploy). AC: specific conditions cho mỗi user story
options.C: DoD là PO define, AC là team define
options.D: AC áp dụng cho toàn team

questions.explanation: DoD: checklist áp dụng cho mọi increment (unit tests, integration tests, code review, deploy to staging, docs updated). Acceptance Criteria: specific scenarios/conditions for particular story để được accept bởi PO.

questions.question: Velocity trong Scrum là gì và cách sử dụng đúng?

options.A: Story points completed per sprint — dùng để forecast, không phải measure productivity

questions.explanation: Velocity: average story points delivered. Dùng để: release planning, sprint planning (không overcommit). KHÔNG dùng để: compare teams, measure developer performance, pressure team. Story points relative, không absolute.

academic.summary: Kanban WIP limits, flow metrics, SAFe PI Planning, OKRs, TDD/BDD, pair programming, code review

market_ready.hands_on_task: Setup Kanban board với WIP limits: Backlog → Ready → In Progress (WIP=2) → Review → Done. Track cycle time

questions.question: WIP (Work In Progress) limits trong Kanban mục đích gì?

options.A: Limit context switching, expose bottlenecks, improve flow và cycle time
options.B: Giới hạn số người trong team
options.D: Không có tác dụng thực tế

questions.explanation: WIP limit: pull system, không push. Context switching overhead giảm. Bottlenecks visible (column đầy → upstream dừng). Little's Law: Cycle Time = WIP / Throughput. Giảm WIP → giảm cycle time.

academic.summary: Epic/Story/Task hierarchy, labels, sprints, filters, dashboards, Confluence documentation

market_ready.hands_on_task: Setup Jira project: epics, stories với acceptance criteria, tasks linked to code. Confluence page cho architecture decision records (ADR)

questions.question: User Story format chuẩn trong Agile?

options.A: As a [role], I want [feature], So that [benefit] — với Acceptance Criteria cụ thể

questions.explanation: As a [user persona], I want [capability], So that [business value]. Acceptance Criteria: Given-When-Then (BDD style). Tốt: testable, independent, small, value-driven. INVEST: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.
